notes: Inspiria: Od začiatku funguje ako v Sampleri – po zapnutí slučky sa navrhne jej stred (30–70 %), predvolene hrá tón hneď v slučke. V zozname zvukov pribudol výber ↺ Naposledy. Audio editor: dvojklik na pravítko ukáže celý zvuk.
notes_en: Inspiria: From start works like in the Sampler – turning the loop on suggests its middle (30–70 %), by default the note plays right in the loop. The sound list has a new ↺ Recent filter. Audio editor: double-click the ruler to see the whole sound.
